tool.name: ai_research_assistant_and_document_generator
tool.description: A powerful AI-driven tool that automates the entire process of researching a given company topic and generating a professionally formatted Word document. It aggregates information from multiple sources including Wikipedia and major financial news outlets to create a comprehensive report. The generated document will automatically include a main title, an introductory summary, a bulleted list of the latest quarterly news updates, and a structured list of main products or vehicle models. Simply provide the company name (e.g., 'NIO') and the desired output file path. This tool streamlines the entire workflow from research to final document creation in a single step, ensuring maximum efficiency and data accuracy.
